mintAuthority.summary: CJPY is minted permissionlessly from Yamato's Liquity-v1-style ETH pledges (130% MCR, one-time fee, no interest). The Yamato contract is a UUPS proxy (ERC1967Proxy) pointing to YamatoV4 implementation; upgrade authority (onlyGovernance) is held by a 2-of-4 Gnosis Safe at 0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec with no modules. CJPY token is non-upgradeable with no owner; its own private governance variable has been permanently renounced (revokeGovernance), so its CurrencyOS pointer is fixed. CurrencyOS itself (which coordinates minting) is a separate UUPS proxy whose upgrade authority resolves to the same 2-of-4 Safe.

controls.label: Yamato pledge contract (ETH CDP mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by the 130% minimum collateralization ratio on ETH pledges, with redemption-based peg defense.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295201, the Yamato proxy (0x02Fe72b2E9fF717EbF3049333B184E9Cd984f257) has EIP-1967 impl slot pointing to YamatoV4 (0x0bfa59f9fbe9565c240cd64311c86e90e59a4838, 29684 bytes); proxy admin slot = 0x0 (UUPS pattern). Users mint CJPY by overcollateralizing ETH at 130% MCR.

controls.label: Yamato governance Safe (upgrade + parameter authority)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295201, governance() on the Yamato proxy returns 0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec (GnosisSafeProxy); getOwners() = 4 addresses; getThreshold() = 2; getModulesPaginated returns empty array (next=sentinel, length=0). YamatoV4 source confirms onlyGovernance modifier gates upgrades and parameter changes.

controls.label: CJPY token private governance (renounced)
controls.capDescription: The pinned Currency.sol source declares a private `governance` slot that alone can call setCurrencyOS(); it exposes no public getter.
controls.evidence: Currency.sol declares `address currencyOS` then `address governance` as its own storage variables, placed after ERC20Permit's inherited layout (_balances, _allowances, _totalSupply, _name, _symbol, _nonces occupy slots 0-5). Direct eth_getStorageAt reads on the CJPY token at Ethereum block 25579969 confirm this: slot 2 held totalSupply, slots 3/4 held the packed name/symbol strings, slot 6 (currencyOS) held 0x000000000000000000000000e69c6bf0a6ea2f12abe054988a3e2091a8a3784f, and slot 7 (governance) read all-zero. Since Currency.sol's only governance-mutating function is revokeGovernance() (no replacement setter exists), a zero value means governance has been permanently renounced: setCurrencyOS() can no longer be called by anyone, so the token's currencyOS pointer (0xe69C6Bf0A6eA2F12aBE054988A3e2091a8a3784f) is now fixed.

controls.label: CurrencyOS UUPS governance (Yamato Safe)
controls.capDescription: CurrencyOS.addYamato/setDeps (registering new Yamato mint sources) and its UUPS _authorizeUpgrade are both gated onlyGovernance.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25579969, CurrencyOS 0xe69C6Bf0A6eA2F12aBE054988A3e2091a8a3784f is a UUPS proxy (EIP-1967 admin slot = 0x0, implementation = 0x811cE73639A05f436a56ea71480cd921a4039542) whose public governance() returns 0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec — the same 2-of-4 Safe already resolved as the Yamato pledge contract's governance. The pinned UUPSBase source confirms _authorizeUpgrade and the onlyGovernance modifier gate both upgrades and CurrencyOS's addYamato/setDeps functions, with a 2-phase setGovernance/acceptGovernance transfer and a revokeGovernance option available to that Safe.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295201: Yamato proxy (0x02Fe72b2E9fF717EbF3049333B184E9Cd984f257) is an ERC1967Proxy (UUPS) pointing to YamatoV4 impl (0x0bfa59f9fbe9565c240cd64311c86e90e59a4838); proxy admin EIP-1967 slot = 0x0 (UUPS). governance() returns 0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec (GnosisSafeProxy, 4 owners, threshold 2, no modules). CJPY token (0x1cfa5641c01406ab8ac350ded7d735ec41298372): EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = 0x0, owner() reverts — immutable non-upgradeable token. Follow-up 2026-07-20: the Yamato pledge contract 0x02Fe72b2E9fF717EbF3049333B184E9Cd984f257 exposes MCR()=130 and feePool() but no aggregate supply cap or debt ceiling getter; CJPY minting is bounded only by per-vault ETH collateral at the MCR, so the economic cap semantics are unbounded. Follow-up 2026-07-21: the CJPY token's own private governance/CurrencyOS route (previously unbound to the Safe) is now resolved by direct storage read — governance slot 7 is all-zero (permanently renounced via revokeGovernance(), no replacement setter exists), so the token's currencyOS pointer (0xe69C6Bf0A6eA2F12aBE054988A3e2091a8a3784f) is fixed. CurrencyOS is a separate UUPS proxy whose public governance() resolves to the same 2-of-4 Yamato Safe (0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec), which is also the sole authority for addYamato/setDeps and CurrencyOS upgrades.
